messages:
emma (Finance): Quick billing update — we're launching a new "surge_protection" credit and a per-route smoothing policy to reduce noisy bursts on invoices. Effective rollout starts next Monday (4/5) and will be fully ramped over ~4 weeks. Details below.

zach (Eng): what does "per-route smoothing" mean for the runtime? do we need SDK changes?

emma (Finance): no SDK changes. Smoothing happens at the rate-limiter layer: short instantaneous spikes are distributed across a configurable window (default 10m) instead of being charged as a single big burst. That lowers token spike charge surprises and improves throttling behavior.

vy (Product): tl;dr for customers — how will this appear on invoices?

emma (Finance): invoices will get a new line-item called "surge_credit" when the protection applies. It offsets the token spike portion of charges up to the account's protection cap. We'll also add a per-route meta field in the UI called "smooth_rate" that shows the applied smoothing window. Internal doc: https://redwood.internal/billing/surge-protection (CS + Sales playbook linked).

billing-bot: NOTE: first invoices with "surge_credit" line will be generated at midnight UTC on 1979991200 for eligible accounts.

sana (Customer Success): will early-stage startups still get their trial credits? any change to the free credit policy?

emma (Finance): startups in the Startup Program get an automatic "starter_surge" bump (one-time) for the first 30d after signup. Free credits remain unchanged; this is an additive temporary buffer to reduce accidental overage charges during onboarding.

zach (Eng): any perf/regressions risk from smoothing? kernel changes?

emma (Finance): no model/kernel work required; this is request-side orchestration. We've load-tested the smoothing queue under 10k rps bursts. Will monitor latency SLOs; rollback plan is ready.

alex (CTO): please make sure eng-observability has dashboards for "smoothing_backlog" and that rollout is feature-flagged per-region.

vy (Product): updated CS/Docs checklist: update pricing page, add FAQ, annotate enterprise agreements that smoothing is opt-out for dedicated customers.

sana (Customer Success): I'll update playbooks and create a canned response for customers who report unexpected line items.

emma (Finance): timeline recap: staging rollout next Monday -> beta accounts (opt-in) first 48 hours -> gradual ramp to all hosted accounts over 4 weeks. Dedicated/Private customers: flow to contact rep for opt-in/opt-out.

zach (Eng): noted. tagging @alex for infra windows.

billing-bot: AUTOMATED REMINDER: Support KB published at 1979991300 -> https://redwood.internal/kb/billing-surge-protection

emma (Finance): if you have questions or legal/contract edge-cases, ping me. We'll post the public-facing explainer on docs.redwood.com before the public rollout. :confetti_ball:

vy (Product): thanks team. will coordinate comms and customer outreach. :raised_hands:
